title: Need 'All-Weather' Portfolio: Tuttle's Newton
summary: Frances Newton, CIO of Tuttle Capital Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ." They discuss a report that the US Treasury could draw down some of its cash pile to fund buybacks of higher-yielding older securities in a bid to tackle rising borrowing costs. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stocks Fall as Chip Rout Overshadows Drop in Oil: Markets Wrap
summary: Wall Street kicked off the week on a cautious note, with a selloff in chipmakers outweighing an oil drop as traders parsed Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s plan to isolate Iran from the global economy.

title: 'True ETF Innovation' Happening at Neos: Goldman's Lake
summary: Bryon Lake, chief transformation officer and global head of third party wealth at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and Troy Cates, co-founder of Neos Investments, join Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ." They discuss how Neos is innovating in the ETF space.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Goldman M&A, NHL Futures | ETF IQ 8/24/2026
summary: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: Byron Lake, Goldman Sachs Asset Management Global Co-Head of Third-Party Wealth, Troy Cates, NEOS Co-Founder, Frances Newton, Tuttle Capital Management CIO, Carlos Pena, Texas Capital Head of ETF and Funds Management, and Nick Samouilhan, Wellington Portfolio Manager. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Goldman, Neos Discuss $2.3 Billion Deal
summary: Bryon Lake, chief transformation officer and global head of third party wealth at Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and Troy Cates, co-founder of Neos Investments, join Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ." Goldman Sachs Asset Management will pay as much as $2.25 billion to buy Neos Investments, expanding its asset manager’s reach in the actively managed exchange-traded fund market.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Tells Iran’s Trade Partners to Cut Ties or Face Sanctions
summary: Vali Nasr, professor of international affairs & Middle East studies at Johns Hopkins University, said that he sees the declaration of new sanctions on Iran and its allies as a 'theatrical declaration' and less of a concrete move by the United States. Nasr said that the pressure on Iran's allies could potentially invite Chinese retaliation, which would widen the war 'out of the gulf and into the financial markets.'  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Protolabs Rides Manufacturing Momentum
summary: US manufacturing is getting a boost from growing demand across defense, aerospace and drones. Protolabs is tapping into that demand, using digital manufacturing to produce custom parts in as little as a day. CEO Suresh Krishna discusses the opportunity on Bloomberg Open Interest. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Natural Gas Inches Up on Record-Breaking Heat, Lower Output
summary: US natural gas ended slightly higher as forecasts shifted hotter over the weekend. Higher temperatures indicate increased demand for the power-plant fuel as consumers ramp up their air-conditioning use. The month is now on track to eclipse 2007 for the hottest population-weighted August on record, according to the private forecaster Commodity Weather Group.

title: USD/CAD rises as US-Canada trade talks fall through
summary: Canada’s currency tumbled against the US dollar by the most in two months after President Donald Trump escalated his trade war with the country by vowing to double tariffs on auto imports.

title: US Stocks Decline as Nvidia Earnings, Jackson Hole Loom
summary: US stocks fell on Monday as investors geared up for a busy week of economic data and earnings from Nvidia Corp.

title: USDA to Reopen Two New Mexico Ports to Mexican Cattle
summary: Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins said the US will reopen two additional ports to cattle shipments from Mexico in 30-day increments after imports restarted at an Arizona port.

title: Clearlake-Backed Software Maker Ivanti’s Earnings Sink 21%
summary: Ivanti Inc. told lenders that second-quarter revenue and earnings fell, casting a cloud over the private equity-backed cybersecurity software firm’s efforts to boost sales following its transition to a subscription-based business model.

title: Guggenheim Loan Drops to New 73-Cent Low With Firm in Spotlight
summary: A loan from Guggenheim Investments’ financing entity slid to a new low on Monday, even after the firm convened a call last week with lenders to assuage concerns about its second-quarter earnings.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 24
summary: Oil held its decline after US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced what he called an “unprecedented” campaign to isolate Iran from the global economy, as the US seeks to pressure Tehran to loosen its grip on the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Bessent Stops Short of New Bond Measures Amid Report on Cash Use
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent refrained from any further signals on revamping US debt management on Monday, following a report that his department could draw down some of its cash pile to fund buybacks of higher-yielding older securities.

title: Bessent Says ‘Wave of Sanctions’ to Come on Iran
summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent speaks about US efforts to sever Iran from the global economy and actions taken by the United Arab Emirates to cut economic ties with the Islamic Republic last week. He also says to expect “a major announcement of a financial institution being sanctioned by the end of this week.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: BlackRock Pitches TCP Private Credit Assets to Rival Managers
summary: BlackRock Inc. is sounding out buyers for all $671 million of loans held by its TCP Capital Corp. as the firm ramps up efforts to overhaul the troubled private credit fund, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

title: The Problem With Treasury Buybacks in the Name of ‘Liquidity’
summary: A target on longer-dated bond yields.

title: Gold Advances to Three-Month High as Debasement Trade Returns
summary: Gold climbed to the highest in more than three months as the US Treasury’s bold intervention in the bond market revived concerns about fiscal policy and its impact on the dollar.

title: Broadcom Credit Risk Soars on Mega AI Debt Financing Backstops
summary: Bond traders have ramped up measures of credit risk associated with Broadcom Inc. as it backstops mega financing packages for the buildout of artificial intelligence.
